name: Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS)
forces_resolved: Independent optimization of write (command) models and read (query) models
Extreme query performance via denormalized read-optimized projections
Elimination of complex multi-table joins on high-traffic read paths
forces_unresolved: Eventual consistency lag between command updates and query projections
Code duplication between command and query domain models
Dual data store synchronization failure modes
applicability_conditions: Massive read/write traffic asymmetry (e.g., 100:1 read-to-write ratio)
Complex search queries requiring denormalized views (e.g. Elasticsearch alongside Postgres)
Domain models where business update rules differ heavily from read DTO requirements
anti_requisites: Strict requirement for immediate read-after-write consistency on query models
Single engineer maintenance without event streaming experience
